title: Run
description: Representation of a run - a conversation or processing session for an agent. Runs track when agents process messages and maintain the relationship between agents, steps, and messages.

id.title: Id
id.description: The human-friendly ID of the Run

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: The timestamp when the run was created.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: The timestamp when the run was completed.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent associated with the run.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation associated with the run.

base_template_id.title: Base Template Id
base_template_id.description: The base template ID that the run belongs to.

background.title: Background
background.description: Whether the run was created in background mode.

request_config.description: The request configuration for the run.

stop_reason.description: The reason why the run was stopped.

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: If set, POST to this URL when the run completes.

callback_sent_at.title: Callback Sent At
callback_sent_at.description: Timestamp when the callback was last attempted.

callback_status_code.title: Callback Status Code
callback_status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the callback endpoint.

callback_error.title: Callback Error
callback_error.description: Optional error message from attempting to POST the callback endpoint.

ttft_ns.title: Ttft Ns
ttft_ns.description: Time to first token for a run in nanoseconds

use_assistant_message.title: Use Assistant Message
use_assistant_message.description: Whether the server should parse specific tool call arguments (default `send_message`) as `AssistantMessage` objects.

assistant_message_tool_name.title: Assistant Message Tool Name
assistant_message_tool_name.description: The name of the designated message tool.

assistant_message_tool_kwarg.title: Assistant Message Tool Kwarg
assistant_message_tool_kwarg.description: The name of the message argument in the designated message tool.

include_return_message_types.title: Include Return Message Types
include_return_message_types.description: Only return specified message types in the response. If `None` (default) returns all messages.
